_readme: The demo video, scene by scene: which stretch of which recorded take is shown, at what speed, with which narration. Clip anchors point at events in the take's events.jsonl: "click:Restock-1" is one second before the click on Restock, "night#2+0.5" half a second after the second night change, a number is seconds into the take. A scene lasts as long as its clips or its narration, whichever is longer; a clip that runs out holds its last frame. *text* in a caption is coloured. See README.md.

cues.caption: Lantern Row: a night market on NEAR. Run a stall and out-trade the merchants.
One tap opens a stall. No wallet, no sign-up: your browser makes a key, and that key owns the stall.
Minted on chain, and there it is on the street.
*Restock* fills the counter from the Dock. *Smart prices* sets what sells tonight.
Each card says how many want the good, and how many will buy at your price.
Every 20 seconds, twelve villagers walk the row with their own wallets and tastes. Coins fly when they buy.
The night report: what sold, who walked away, and why.
Then one call to make. A festival of lamp oil starts next night: stock up?
The festival comes, with bunting and fireworks, and everyone wants lamp oil.
The next report says how the call went. When it paid off: *stamped*.
The deed. A stall is an NFT that holds its own coin and goods: sell it, and all of it goes along.
The founder earns 5% of every resale. List it, and the sign goes up.
*For sale* on the street, for anyone with the coin.
Ranks: your stall against the six merchants, and every other player on the row.
Every tap was a real transaction on NEAR testnet. The proof drawer lists each one.

card.heading: Why NEAR

points.title: An unpatchable shared world
points.text: The contract has no keys. Nobody can change a rule or mint coin: one closed economy, the same for everyone.

points.title: Stalls are NFTs that own money and stock
points.text: The token is the account: coin, goods, prices and reputation live under the token id and move with it.

points.title: Play with no wallet
points.text: Your browser's key signs each order; scoped relay keys pay the gas and can only call the game.

card.question: Where would you put your stall: *by the gate*, or where the rent is low?
